# Ivan Prlić (Prlić Consulting)

> Ivan Prlić is a solutions architect, AI consultant and AWS Authorized Instructor based in Zagreb, Croatia, and the founder of Prlić Consulting d.o.o. He holds Claude Certified Architect – Professional and teaches Claude and AWS courses for business and engineering teams, online or on site anywhere in Europe, in English or Croatian. He also offers fixed-scope AI advisory and cloud architecture for regulated organisations.

Facts on this page are taken from prlic.io. Prices are "from" prices in EUR, excluding VAT and travel. The Claude courses are independent exam preparation, not official Anthropic courses.

## About Ivan

- [Home: AI advisory and cloud architecture](https://prlic.io/): 20+ years in software and 10+ on AWS; AWS Authorized Instructor; certifications across AWS, Google Cloud, Azure and Claude, including Claude Certified Architect – Professional and AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional. Builds production AI on Claude and Amazon Bedrock for regulated organisations. Works remotely across EU and US time zones and travels only to deliver on-site training. English (C2) and Croatian (native).
- [Conference talks](https://prlic.io/talks/): talks with slides.
- [Croatian version of the site](https://prlic.io/hr/)

## Claude training (certification exam preparation)

Each course is delivered live, online in half-day blocks or on site anywhere in Europe (travel charged at cost), in English or Croatian, for up to 20 participants per group, and can be tailored to the team. Team training starts from EUR 4,000 for a course of one to two days, excluding VAT and travel; the price depends on length, format and group size. Exams are taken at Pearson VUE; candidates register through the Anthropic Partner Academy, which requires their company to be a member of the Claude Partner Network.

- [Claude Training overview](https://prlic.io/training/): all Claude, practical AI and AWS courses, with FAQ.
- [Claude for Business Teams](https://prlic.io/training/claude-associate/): 1 day, for business professionals, no coding. Prompting, checking output, workflows, Projects and safe use of company data. Prepares for the Claude Certified Associate – Foundations exam (CCAO-F). Croatian: [Claude za poslovne timove](https://prlic.io/hr/edukacija/claude-associate/).
- [Building with Claude](https://prlic.io/training/claude-developer/): 2 days, hands-on coding for developers. Claude API, prompt and context engineering, tools and MCP, agents, Claude Code, security and evals. Prepares for the Claude Certified Developer – Foundations exam (CCDV-F). Croatian: [Razvoj s Claudeom](https://prlic.io/hr/edukacija/claude-developer/).
- [Architecting with Claude](https://prlic.io/training/claude-architect/): 2 days, for architects and senior engineers. Agentic loops and the Agent SDK, multi-agent orchestration, MCP, Claude Code in CI, structured output and reliability. Prepares for the Claude Certified Architect – Foundations exam (CCAR-F). Croatian: [Arhitektura s Claudeom](https://prlic.io/hr/edukacija/claude-architect/).
- [Advanced Claude Architecture](https://prlic.io/training/claude-architect-professional/): 3 days, for senior architects and tech leads. Solution design, RAG, MCP and identity, evaluation, governance and team enablement, with a capstone design case and a full mock exam. Prepares for the Claude Certified Architect – Professional exam (CCAR-P). Croatian: [Napredna arhitektura s Claudeom](https://prlic.io/hr/edukacija/claude-architect-professional/).
- [Which Claude certification should I take?](https://prlic.io/training/claude-certifications/): the Claude certifications compared, with the matching prep courses.
- [Who can take the Claude certification exams?](https://prlic.io/training/claude-exam-eligibility/): exam registration and Claude Partner Network membership, and what other companies can do to train their teams.
- [Free Claude practice questions](https://prlic.io/training/claude-mock-exams/): 20 free practice questions per Claude exam (CCAO-F, CCDV-F, CCAR-F, CCAR-P), with an explanation for every answer. English only.

Anthropic updates the CCAO-F, CCDV-F and CCAR-P exam content on 7 December 2026; those courses are reviewed against the new exam guides before any delivery after that date.

## Practical AI courses (not tied to an exam)

- [Build AI Agents with Claude](https://prlic.io/training/build-ai-agents/): no coding, for business professionals. Eight live two-hour sessions as a 6-week online cohort (16 hours), or 3 days in-house for one team, online or on site. Each participant builds a working agent for a process from their own job. Croatian: [Izgradite AI agente s Claudeom](https://prlic.io/hr/edukacija/ai-agenti/).
- AI Strategy for Leaders: half a day, for leadership teams; where AI pays off, risk and governance including the EU AI Act, build versus buy, a prioritised use-case shortlist and a 90-day plan. Online or on site. Outline on request.
- Claude Code for Engineering Teams: 2 days, hands-on, for software engineers; CLAUDE.md, plan mode, skills, subagents, hooks, MCP, CI and headless use, security and cost. Outline on request.

## AWS training

- [AWS Training](https://prlic.io/training/#aws): official AWS Training and Certification courses taught as an AWS Authorized Instructor, delivered with an AWS Training Partner (priced by that partner); a hands-on Generative AI on AWS workshop on Amazon Bedrock; cloud architecture workshops; AWS certification preparation.
